# Config reference

The config loads from four layers (a lower one overrides a higher one): global `~/.agentic/config.yaml` (+ the active profile)
→ team workspace `.agentic/config.yaml` → repo `.agentic/config.yaml` → flow. Objects merge recursively,
arrays are replaced whole. To see the result: `agentic config show`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles` | map | `{}` | Profiles (usually in the global config `~/.agentic/config.yaml`). |
| `profiles.<name>.match` | object |  | Match conditions (globs). One match is enough. |
| `profiles.<name>.match.remote` | string |  | Glob on the `origin` URL, e.g. `*gitlab.example.com*`. |
| `profiles.<name>.match.path` | string |  | Glob on the repo path, e.g. `~/projects/**`. |
| `profiles.<name>.billing` | `api` \| `subscription` |  | Billing: API (tokens/USD) or subscription. |
| `profiles.<name>.pricing` | map |  | Prices per model alias (USD per 1M tokens). |
| `profiles.<name>.pricing.<name>.in` | number |  | Input (USD / 1M tokens). |
| `profiles.<name>.pricing.<name>.out` | number |  | Output (USD / 1M tokens). |
| `profiles.<name>.pricing.<name>.cache_read` | number |  | Prompt cache read; unset = the `in` price. |
| `profiles.<name>.budget` | object |  | Usage limits for the whole flow, checked before each session from `usage.jsonl`: minutes = total time of sessions without a human (not the grill, not waiting at gates). Going over = a question: continue with the limit +50% or pause. |
| `profiles.<name>.budget.minutes` | number |  | Flow time limit (minutes). |
| `profiles.<name>.budget.tokens` | integer |  | Token limit (input + output). |
| `profiles.<name>.budget.usd` | number |  | Cost limit in USD (needs `pricing`). |
| `profiles.<name>.tracker` | object |  | Issue tracker (import/export only). |
| `profiles.<name>.tracker.type` | `jira` \| `github` \| `none` |  | Tracker type. |
| `profiles.<name>.tracker.url` | string |  | Instance URL (Jira). |
| `profiles.<name>.tracker.project` | string |  | Project key (Jira) or `owner/repo` (GitHub). |
| `profiles.<name>.tracker.auth` | object |  | Where to get the token from; never inline in the file. |
| `profiles.<name>.tracker.auth.env` | string |  | Name of the environment variable holding the token. |
| `profiles.<name>.tracker.auto_push` | `ask` \| `never` \| `always` |  | Whether to push the ticket after the `ticket` gate. |
| `profiles.<name>.forge` | object |  | Forge for `agentic publish`: the orchestrator calls the REST API; the agent never gets the token. |
| `profiles.<name>.forge.type` | `github` \| `gitlab` \| `none` |  | Code platform: `none` = `publish` only pushes the branch and prints a link to create the PR. |
| `profiles.<name>.forge.url` | string |  | Instance URL (GitHub Enterprise, self-hosted GitLab); unset = the host of `origin`. |
| `profiles.<name>.forge.auth` | `{env: string}` \| `{from: undefined}` |  | Where to get the token from; never inline in the file. |
| `profiles.<name>.on_rate_limit` | `pause_and_notify` \| `wait` \| `fail` |  | What to do on a rate limit: pause, wait for the limit reset (at most 5 h, then pause) or fail. |
| `profiles.<name>.tiers` | object |  | Maps a task difficulty tier to an executor. |
| `profiles.<name>.tiers.mechanical` | [executor](#executor) |  |  |
| `profiles.<name>.tiers.standard` | [executor](#executor) |  |  |
| `profiles.<name>.tiers.domain` | [executor](#executor) |  |  |
| `profiles.<name>.tiers.design` | [executor](#executor) |  |  |
| `default_profile` | string |  | The profile when no `match` fits. |
| `workspaces` | string[] |  | Trusted workspace directories (global config only). A workspace inside a repo that is not on the list cannot set `sandbox`. |
| `tiers` | object |  | Maps a task difficulty tier to an executor. |
| `tiers.mechanical` | [executor](#executor) | `{"harness":"codex","model":"luna","effort":"low"}` |  |
| `tiers.standard` | [executor](#executor) | `{"harness":"codex","model":"luna","effort":"medium"}` |  |
| `tiers.domain` | [executor](#executor) | `{"harness":"codex","model":"sol","effort":"high"}` |  |
| `tiers.design` | [executor](#executor) | `{"harness":"claude","model":"opus","effort":"high"}` |  |
| `stages` | object |  | Stage settings: the stage skill and practice skills. The implement executor comes from `tiers`, review from `review.<axis>`, fix from the group; those stages only set skills (fix also an executor override). |
| `stages.grill-business` | object |  | Stage settings: executor + skills. |
| `stages.grill-business.harness` | `claude` \| `codex` | `"claude"` | The agent CLI. |
| `stages.grill-business.model` | string | `"opus"` | Model alias from the catalog (e.g. `opus`, `luna`). |
| `stages.grill-business.effort` | `low` \| `medium` \| `high` \| `xhigh` \| `max` \| `ultra` | `"high"` | Effort (reasoning) level. |
| `stages.grill-business.skills` | string[] | `[]` | Practice skills for the stage. Prefixes: `team:` (workspace), `repo:` (service), none (global/framework). |
| `stages.grill-business.stage_skill` | string |  | Replaces the stage skill (must keep the output contract). |
| `stages.grill-technical` | object |  | Stage settings: executor + skills. |
| `stages.grill-technical.harness` | `claude` \| `codex` | `"claude"` | The agent CLI. |

| `stages.grill-technical.skills` | string[] | `[]` | Practice skills for the stage. Prefixes: `team:` (workspace), `repo:` (service), none (global/framework). |
| `stages.grill-technical.stage_skill` | string |  | Replaces the stage skill (must keep the output contract). |
| `stages.breakdown` | object |  | Stage settings: executor + skills. |
| `stages.breakdown.harness` | `claude` \| `codex` | `"claude"` | The agent CLI. |
| `stages.breakdown.model` | string | `"opus"` | Model alias from the catalog (e.g. `opus`, `luna`). |

| `stages.write-tests` | object |  | The `write-tests` stage: executor, skills and switch. |

| `review` | object |  | The review loop. |
| `review.spec` | [executor](#executor) \| null | `{"harness":"codex","model":"sol","effort":"medium"}` | Reviewer for the spec axis (does it deliver the ticket/spec/ACs). `null` = axis off. |
| `review.standards` | [executor](#executor) \| null | `{"harness":"claude","model":"opus","effort":"high"}` | Reviewer for the standards axis (archetype/conventions/quality). `null` = axis off. |
| `review.security` | [executor](#executor) \| null | `null` | Reviewer for the security axis (trust boundaries, where untrusted input ends up). `null` = axis off. |
| `review.final` | [executor](#executor) | `{"harness":"claude","model":"opus","effort":"high"}` | Final review of the whole feature. |
| `review.checks` | string[] \| string | `[]` | The deterministic gate: build/test/lint commands (each through `sh -c` in the group clone). Required to start a flow; `none` = knowingly without verification (groups marked "unverified"). With `sandbox.mode: none` they need consent per repo (`~/.agentic/trusted-checks.yaml`). |
| `review.compile` | string |  | Compiles code and tests without running them (e.g. `./gradlew testClasses`): the "red" gate after `write-tests` and the gate after each task. With `sandbox.mode: none` covered by the same consent as `checks`. |
| `review.test_reports` | string |  | Glob of JUnit XML reports relative to the clone (e.g. `**/build/test-results/test/*.xml`); without them the test gates fall back to the exit codes of `checks`. The "red" gate needs a report from every test suite while others are red: the command must not stop at the first red task (Gradle: `--continue`, and when one task depends on another, separate commands, e.g. `./gradlew test` and `./gradlew integration -x test`). |
| `review.checks_timeout` | string | `"5m"` | Time limit for one `checks` command, e.g. `5m`, `90s`; capped at `checks_timeout_max`. |
| `review.checks_timeout_max` | string | `"60m"` | Hard ceiling for `checks_timeout`. Global config only. |
| `review.max_rounds` | integer | `2` | Maximum number of review → fix rounds. |
| `review.stop_on` | `max_rounds` \| `repeated_finding` \| `disputed` \| `no_progress` \| `budget` \| `{diff_growth: number}` \| `{checks_failing: integer}` \| `{rejection_rate: number}`[] | (see below) | Loop stop triggers: `max_rounds`, `repeated_finding`, `disputed`, `no_progress`, `{diff_growth: x}`, `{checks_failing: n}`, `{rejection_rate: x}`; `budget` changes nothing (the flow budget is always checked). |
| `review.on_stop` | `escalate` \| `human` \| `fail`[] | `["human"]` | Action chain after a stop: `escalate` (a fixer round one rung up in `escalation`; past the top, the chain goes on), `human`, `fail`. |
| `review.escalation` | string[] | `[]` | Model ladder for `escalate` (e.g. `[luna, sol, astra]`), starting above the fixer model. Empty = off. |
| `skills` | object |  | Framework and team skills across the whole flow. The array replaces the one from a lower layer (repo overrides workspace). |
| `skills.disabled` | string[] |  | Practice skills turned off in all stages (e.g. `agentic-clean-code`); a stage skill cannot be turned off, `stage_skill` replaces it. |
| `rules` | object |  | Single rules of standards and skills. The array replaces the one from a lower layer. |
| `rules.disabled` | string[] |  | Rules turned off by ID (e.g. `AG-CODE-03`): the skill stays, agents do not apply the rule, review does not report it. |
| `language` | object |  | Flow languages. Skills and contracts are always in English. |
| `language.artifacts` | string | `"en"` | Language of flow artifacts (ticket, spec, reports); set by the team/repo. |
| `language.conversation` | string |  | Language of the conversation in interactive stages (personal); unset = same as `artifacts`. |
| `language.pr` | string |  | Language of the PR/MR description from `agentic publish` (team); unset = same as `artifacts`. When it differs from the conversation language, the technical grill also writes `pr_summary` in it; risks and review findings stay in the artifacts language. |
| `autonomy` | `strict` \| `standard` \| `autopilot` \| `custom` | `"standard"` | Gate preset. `custom` needs `gates`. |
| `gates` | `ticket` \| `spec` \| `breakdown` \| `group` \| `merge` \| `final`[] |  | Active gates with `autonomy: custom`. |
| `budget` | object |  | Usage limits for the whole flow, checked before each session from `usage.jsonl`: minutes = total time of sessions without a human (not the grill, not waiting at gates). Going over = a question: continue with the limit +50% or pause. |
| `budget.minutes` | number | `60` | Flow time limit (minutes). |
| `budget.tokens` | integer |  | Token limit (input + output). |
| `budget.usd` | number |  | Cost limit in USD (needs `pricing`). |
| `session_timeout` | string | `"45m"` | Time limit for one session without a human, e.g. `45m`; past it the session is killed and the group paused. Interactive sessions have no limit. |
| `sandbox` | object |  | The implementation sandbox. |
| `sandbox.mode` | `container` \| `none` | `"container"` | `container` = sessions in a container; `none` = local without isolation (with a warning). |
| `sandbox.engine` | `podman` \| `docker` | `"podman"` | Container engine for `mode: container`. |
| `sandbox.network` | `{allow: array}` |  |  |
| `sandbox.network.allow` | string[] | (see below) | Host allowlist. |
| `sandbox.image` | object |  |  |
| `sandbox.image.base` | string | `"agentic/base"` | Base image. |
| `sandbox.image.stack` | string | `"auto"` | Stack layer: `auto` (build files in the repo or a top-level directory: Gradle/Maven → `jvm`, otherwise the base image), `jvm` (JDK 17/21/25), `none`/`node` (the base image has Node), or the name of your own image. |
| `sandbox.containers` | boolean | `false` | Containers inside a session (Testcontainers, `docker compose`): rootless Podman in the session container, with `DOCKER_HOST` on its socket; Docker Hub images through the allowlist, each session has its own storage (removed with it). Weaker isolation (docs/en/security.md): only for repos that need it. |
| `sandbox.caches` | `gradle` \| `maven` \| `npm` \| `playwright`[] | `["gradle","maven","npm","playwright"]` | Shared dependency caches (`agentic-cache-*` volumes, common to all sessions). |
| `sandbox.host` | object |  | Reads outside the session directories with `mode: none`. |
| `sandbox.host.read` | string[] | (see below) | Parts of the home directory a host session may read, with the shell and file tools (toolchains, dependency caches, working material next to the repo); the rest of home is closed, credentials always. Global config only. |
| `sandbox.host.deny` | string[] | `[]` | Extra paths closed to host sessions (besides the built-in credentials list). |
| `git` | object |  |  |
| `git.branch_prefix` | string | `"agentic/"` | Prefix of flow branches. |
| `git.branch_pattern` | string | `"{type}/{ticket}-{title}"` | Name of the branch `publish` pushes: `{type}` (from commits: `feat`, `fix`…), `{ticket}` (tracker key without `#`), `{title}` (ticket title as a slug), `{slug}` (the flow slug), `{group}` (group title as a slug; one PR for everything: the ticket title). In a stack a pattern without `{group}` gets a `-1`, `-2`, … suffix; a flow with one group has no suffix. |
| `git.commit_convention` | `conventional` \| `free` | `"conventional"` | The agent commit convention. |
| `notify` | object |  | Notifications. |
| `notify.on` | `human_needed` \| `group_blocked` \| `flow_paused` \| `rate_limited` \| `group_done` \| `flow_done` \| `flow_failed`[] | (see below) | Events to notify about; `group_blocked` and `flow_paused` skip pauses a human chose (stop at a gate), and a flow pause after an already reported group notifies once. |
| `notify.command` | string |  | A command (`sh -c`) instead of the terminal bell, e.g. `afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff`; gets `AGENTIC_EVENT`, `AGENTIC_SLUG`, `AGENTIC_GROUP`, `AGENTIC_MESSAGE`. Global config only. |
| `publish` | object |  | `agentic publish`. |
| `publish.one_way_paths` | string[] | (see below) | Globs of paths whose change is one-way (migrations, contracts): `publish` says so in the PR "Merge danger" section, and the `final` gate then asks in every preset. The array replaces the one from a lower layer. |
| `publish.stack` | boolean | `true` | A stack of PRs: the groups of one repo form a chain (breakdown must cut the plan that way), each becomes a PR on the branch of the previous one. `false` = groups of one repo may run in parallel, `publish` makes one PR for everything. |
| `publish.size` | object |  | Change size: production / test / excluded lines, with soft thresholds. |
| `publish.size.max_prod_lines` | integer | `400` | Soft threshold for production lines (added + deleted, docs count); going over = a warning in the `publish` plan, in the PR description and on a finished group whose estimate was under the threshold (or over it, and the diff exceeded 2× the estimate). |
| `publish.size.max_total_lines` | integer | `800` | Soft threshold for production and test lines together; going over = a warning. |
| `publish.size.tests` | string[] | (see below) | Globs of test files, counted apart from production ones. The array replaces the one from a lower layer. |
| `publish.size.exclude` | string[] | (see below) | Globs of files left out of the size (lockfiles, generated files); files marked `linguist-generated` in `.gitattributes` are always left out. The array replaces the one from a lower layer. |
| `parallel_groups` | integer | `1` | How many implement groups (without mutual dependencies) may run at once. |
| `sync` | `{policy: undefined}` |  |  |
| `sync.policy` | `auto` \| `warn` \| `block` | `"auto"` | Workspace sync at the start of a flow. |
| `requires_framework` | string |  | Required framework version (semver range), e.g. `>=1.4`. |

## Executor

The `{ harness, model, effort }` object used in `tiers`, `stages`, `review`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `harness` | `claude` \| `codex` | The agent CLI; omitted = inferred from the model catalog. |
| `model` | string | Alias from the model catalog (`agentic models`). |
| `effort` | `low` \| `medium` \| `high` \| `xhigh` \| `max` | Effort level; availability depends on the model. |

## Defaults

```yaml
profiles: {}
tiers:
  mechanical:
    harness: codex
    model: luna
    effort: low
  standard:
    harness: codex
    model: luna
    effort: medium
  domain:
    harness: codex
    model: sol
    effort: high
  design:
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    effort: high
stages:
  grill-business:
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    effort: high
    skills: []
  grill-technical:
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    effort: high
    skills: []
  breakdown:
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    effort: medium
    skills: []
  write-tests:
    harness: codex
    model: sol
    effort: medium
    skills:
      - agentic-test-quality
    enabled: true
  implement:
    skills:
      - agentic-test-quality
      - agentic-clean-code
  fix:
    skills:
      - agentic-test-quality
      - agentic-clean-code
  merge:
    skills: []
  review-spec:
    skills: []
  review-standards:
    skills:
      - agentic-test-quality
      - agentic-clean-code
  review-security:
    skills: []
  review-final:
    skills: []
review:
  spec:
    harness: codex
    model: sol
    effort: medium
  standards:
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    effort: high
  security: null
  final:
    harness: claude
    model: opus
    effort: high
  checks: []
  checks_timeout: 5m
  checks_timeout_max: 60m
  max_rounds: 2
  stop_on:
    - repeated_finding
    - disputed
    - no_progress
    - diff_growth: 1.5
    - checks_failing: 3
    - rejection_rate: 0.5
  on_stop:
    - human
  escalation: []
language:
  artifacts: en
autonomy: standard
budget:
  minutes: 60
session_timeout: 45m
sandbox:
  mode: container
  engine: podman
  network:
    allow:
      - api.anthropic.com
      - api.openai.com
      - repo.maven.apache.org
      - registry.npmjs.org
  image:
    base: agentic/base
    stack: auto
  containers: false
  caches:
    - gradle
    - maven
    - npm
    - playwright
  host:
    read:
      - ~/.gitconfig
      - ~/.config/git
      - ~/.m2
      - ~/.gradle
      - ~/.npm
      - ~/.nvm
      - ~/.sdkman
    deny: []
git:
  branch_prefix: agentic/
  branch_pattern: "{type}/{ticket}-{title}"
  commit_convention: conventional
publish:
  one_way_paths:
    - "**/db/migration/**"
    - "**/migrations/**"
    - "**/V*__*.sql"
    - "**/*.proto"
    - "**/*.avsc"
  stack: true
  size:
    max_prod_lines: 400
    max_total_lines: 800
    tests:
      - "**/test/**"
      - "**/tests/**"
      - "**/__tests__/**"
      - "**/src/test/**"
      - "**/*.test.*"
      - "**/*.spec.*"
      - "**/*Test.java"
      - "**/*Tests.java"
      - "**/*IT.java"
      - "**/*_test.go"
      - "**/test_*.py"
      - "**/*_test.py"
    exclude:
      - "**/package-lock.json"
      - "**/yarn.lock"
      - "**/pnpm-lock.yaml"
      - "**/Cargo.lock"
      - "**/go.sum"
      - "**/poetry.lock"
      - "**/uv.lock"
      - "**/Gemfile.lock"
      - "**/composer.lock"
      - "**/gradle.lockfile"
      - "**/generated/**"
      - "**/*.generated.*"
      - "**/*.pb.go"
      - "**/*_pb2.py"
      - "**/*.min.js"
      - "**/__snapshots__/**"
notify:
  on:
    - human_needed
    - group_blocked
    - flow_paused
    - group_done
    - flow_done
    - flow_failed
parallel_groups: 1
sync:
  policy: auto
```
